# Garema Place Surgery — Full Site Content

> Your GP in Canberra City

---

## Home

Garema Place Surgery has been providing health care to residents of the city and surrounding areas since 2000. Our aim is to provide you with comprehensive health care in a convenient location. Our philosophy is that General Practice is the cornerstone of health care and we believe in a holistic approach to your health, focusing not only on management of conditions but prevention.

### Garema Place Surgery is now part of YourGP
We're pleased to let you know that as of 24 June 2026, Garema Place Surgery has officially joined the YourGP family.

Nothing changes for you as a patient. Your doctors and the team you know are staying the same, and our focus on high-quality, patient-first care continues without interruption.

Drs John and Mel Deery are the owners of YourGP.

Thank you for your continued trust and support as we begin this new chapter together.

---

## Doctors

### Dr Daniel Mogg
Dr Daniel Mogg grew up in regional South East Queensland and completed his medical degree at the Australian National University in 2018. He gained Fellowship with the RACGP following clinical experience in hospitals across Canberra and the NSW South Coast.

Dr Mogg also holds postgraduate qualifications in psychology and has worked within the Commonwealth Public Service. He has an interest in all aspects of general practice and is committed to providing comprehensive, patient-centred care.

Dr Mogg is seeing new patients.

### Dr Felicity Donaghy
Dr Felicity Donaghy graduated from Sydney University and completed her General Practice Fellowship in 1991. She has worked in General Practice since 1990. Dr Donaghy has worked in Canberra since 2004. Dr Donaghy enjoys all aspects of General Practice and believes that a good relationship with a caring General Practitioner is the key to maintaining good health.

Dr Donaghy is not currently seeing new patients.

### Dr Libby Goodchild
Dr Libby Goodchild grew up in Canberra. She completed an Arts Degree at Macquarie University before returning to Canberra to work in the community sector. She went on to study Medicine at the University of Newcastle and returned to Canberra in 2000 to complete a Diploma in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Dr Goodchild finished her General Practice training in 2004. She became a Lactation Consultant in 2013 and a member of the Academy of Breastfeeding Medicine. She has been working at Garema Place Surgery since July 2015. Dr Goodchild has a special interest in Breastfeeding Medicine including tongue tie assessment and treatment.

Dr Goodchild is not currently seeing new patients. (Tongue tie/Lactation consultation only accepted)

### Dr Natasha Greer
Dr Natasha Greer is a GP and NDC Accredited Practitioner. Natasha's special interests are perinatal care, breastfeeding medicine, infant care and IUD insertion.

She completed medical school and her general practice fellowship in Sydney before relocating to her hometown of Canberra. She commenced working at Garema Place Surgery in 2018.

Dr Greer is not currently seeing new general practice patients but does see new patients for: preconception and pregnancy care, antenatal breastfeeding preparation, breastfeeding support, unsettled baby support, baby and toddler sleep support and IUD insertion.

Please see her website for more details: www.drnatashagreer.com.au

### Dr Peter Barger
Dr Peter Barger grew up in northern NSW. He completed a postgraduate engineering degree and worked for Defence for 7 years then moved to Adelaide to study medicine. He graduated with a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery from Flinders University in 2011 and worked in a variety of hospital-based jobs for several years before returning to Canberra with his family to begin general practice training in 2016. He joined Garema Place Surgery in February 2018.

Dr Barger is seeing new patients.

### Dr Kate Eisenberg
Dr Kate Eisenberg is a General Practitioner and GP Obstetrician who completed her medical training at the Australian National University in 2013, following an Honours degree in Neuroscience and Anatomy. In addition to her RACGP fellowship, she has a Diploma in Obstetrics and Gynaecology and National Certificate in Reproductive and Sexual Health. She has special interests in reproductive choice, pregnancy shared-care, contraception (including IUD and implanon insertions) and menopausal medicine.

Kate is a strong advocate for women in the sciences, receiving awards including ACT Young Woman of the Year and has been a finalist for Young Australian of the Year (ACT). She enjoys wholistic general practice care, focussing on preventative health. Kate joined Garema Place Surgery in February 2021.

Dr Eisenberg is not currently seeing new patients. (IUD consultation only accepted)

### Dr Katherine Simpson
Dr Katherine Simpson grew up in Sydney, before studying medicine at Newcastle University. She moved the Canberra to undertake her hospital training, and then General Practice training, including training at Garema Place Surgery in 2015. She has been working as a GP in Orange, NSW for the past 6 years. She enjoys all aspects of general practice.

Dr Simpson is seeing new patients.

### Dr Peter Robens
Dr Peter Robens graduates from the Australian National University in 2018 after growing up and completing undergraduate studies in Sydney.

Dr Robens has practiced in Canberra tertiary hospitals for seven years with significant experience in emergency/critical care medicine, general medicine and oncology.

Dr Robens is interested in all areas of general practice with special interests in acute medicine, oncology, cardiology and preventive medicine.

Dr Robens is seeing new patients.

## Services

Garema Place Surgery has been providing health care to residents of the city and surrounding areas since 2000. Our aim is to provide you with comprehensive health care in a convenient location. Our philosophy is that General Practice is the cornerstone of health care and we believe in a holistic approach to your health, focusing not only on management of conditions but prevention. We would like Garema Place Surgery to be your healthcare home.

### Our services include
- Women's Health
- Breastfeeding Medicine
- Men's Health
- Paediatrics and childhood health checks
- Tongue Tie assessment/release
- IUD insertion
- Immunisation
- Travel medicine and vaccination including Yellow Fever
- Chronic disease management/Care Plans
- Skin Cancer Screening
- Pre employment medicals
- Minor Skin Procedures
- Audiometry
- Spirometry
- Health Assessments
- Telehealth Appointments

### Recalls
We operate a recall system to assist you in maintaining optimal health. We will send reminders via SMS reminder, phone call or letter when you are due for repeat examination or investigation.

### Investigation results
We believe that investigation results should be communicated within an appointment. This allows for adequate explanation and discussion and further management to be planned.

It is advisable to make an appointment with your Doctor once you have had the investigation.

All results are received electronically so there is no need for you to bring them with you.

We will send an SMS or will telephone you if you have results to be discussed and have not made an appointment.

If there is an urgent need to discuss results you will be contacted by your Doctor.

### Repeat Prescription, Referral, Pathology and Radiology Requests
Requests for repeat prescriptions and referrals do require an appointment so that your health can be appropriately and safely monitored.

Please book online or call (02 6257 1000) Reception to book an appointment.

### Privacy Policy and Client Charter
Our service is guided by our Client Charter and privacy policy. A Client Charter and the full Privacy Policy are available for download from the Services page.

## Hours

Monday to Friday - 8.00am until 6.00pm
Saturday - 9.00am until 12.00pm
Closed Sundays and all Public Holidays

We are located in Garema Place on the 1st Floor of the Florina Building above Capital Pathology.

There is lift access on the ground floor next to Capital Pathology and stair access beside Impact Comics and Rodger Bartholemew Menswear. Please note that the lift is operational from 8.00am till 5.30pm weekdays and 9.00am till 12.00pm Saturday.

After hours care is provided by Canberra Afterhours Locum Medical Service CALMS Located at Calvary and Canberra Hospitals. Calms can be contacted on (02) 6260 3300.

More information regarding after hours services can be found at findahealthservice.act.gov.au.

## Bookings

### Make a booking by phone
Bookings can be made on the telephone from Monday to Friday 8.00am to 6.00pm and from 9.00am to 12.00pm on Saturday. Call: 02 6257 1000.

### Online booking
Online bookings may be made at any time using our online booking service through the website or on your smartphone: https://automedsystems.com.au/ams/clinics/40/garema-place-surgery-canberra-city-2601/doctors/

### Our aim is to provide a same day appointment wherever possible
We reserve several appointments each day for urgent matters and on the day consultations. Please indicate to our reception team if you require an urgent appointment.

Our aim is to provide a same day appointment wherever possible. Our standard appointments are booked for 15 minutes.

Please request a longer appointment if you have several issues to discuss. This will help us to run on time and not keep you waiting.

Procedures such as excisions and Care Plans for Chronic Disease Management require longer appointments. Please indicate this to our reception team at the time of booking.

Garema Place Surgery uses an SMS system to remind you of the date and time of your appointment.

If you are unable to attend your appointment we would appreciate a telephone call at least 2 hours prior to your appointment time.

If you have booked your appointment online cancellations can also be made through the online booking system. If you fail to attend your appointment, or cancel with less than 2 business hours notice the full consult fee will be charged. You may cancel an appointment via email, phone or online if booked online. Repeated nonattendance without cancellation may result in a request to seek medical care with another Health Care Provider.

### New patients are very welcome at Garema Place Surgery
Bookings can be made on the telephone from Monday to Friday 8.00am to 6.00pm and from 9.00am to 12.00pm on Saturday.

Online bookings may be made at any time using our online booking service through the website or on your smartphone.

New and existing patients are able to book appointments online via our website or by downloading the AMS Doc Connect app for your iPhone or iPad from the App Store. New patients are very welcome at Garema Place Surgery.

### Telehealth Consultation
Telehealth is convenient and appropriate if you are unwell and require isolation from others to prevent disease transmission.

We offer both video and telephone consultations.

Please be aware there may be no Medicare rebate for a Telehealth consult if you are a new patient or have not been to the practice in the last 12 months.

---

## Fees

Garema Place Surgery is a private billing Medical Practice and payment is requested at the time of consultation. We are unable to issue accounts. Payment methods are cash, eftpos or credit card. We do not accept DVA cards as payment.

We have Medicare Easyclaim and are able to process your Medicare refund. Fees vary according to the Medicare item number which takes into account the duration of the consultation. Procedures and Chronic Disease Management consultations are charged differently to a Standard Consultation.

A Standard Consultation (under 20 minutes) is $115.00 (Saturday fee $130.00), a Long Consultation (20–40 minutes) is $205.00, and a Prolonged Consultation (over 40 minutes) is $280.00. Concession card rates and Medicare rebates are detailed in the full fee list, available from Reception. If the fee differs from a Standard Consultation this will be discussed with you by your health care provider.

## Careers

### Join Our Team
Garema Place Surgery is an established, well-respected general practice in Canberra City. We're looking for dedicated GPs, nurses, and admin professionals to join our supportive, collaborative team.

### Why Work With Us
- Established practice with a loyal, growing patient base
- Supportive, collaborative clinical team
- Conveniently located in Canberra City
- Modern facilities and equipment
- Strong culture of clinical excellence and professional development

### General Practitioners
We welcome experienced GPs and registrars. Work flexibly within a practice that values clinical autonomy. Our strong patient base provides excellent continuity of care, and we offer comprehensive support from nursing and administrative staff.

Special interests in areas such as women's health, paediatrics, dermatology, and minor procedures are well-supported. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality, evidence-based general practice.

### Nurses
Our nursing team provides vital clinical support and patient care. We're looking for experienced nurses who enjoy face-to-face patient contact, health coaching, and clinical procedures. Be part of a team that invests in ongoing professional development and values your contribution to patient outcomes.

Opportunities exist for expanding your skills across a breadth of general practice areas, with a supportive environment that encourages continuous learning.

### Administration Team
Our admin team is the backbone of our practice, managing patient interactions, bookings, and GP support. If you're keen to learn, enjoy helping others, and have strong attention to detail, we'd love to hear from you. We invest in training and create clear career pathways for staff who are passionate about improving patient experience.

Work as part of a friendly, supportive team in a busy, rewarding healthcare environment.

### Ready to Join Us?
Get in touch to discuss opportunities, or send your CV and a brief cover letter expressing your interest in joining our team.

## Contact Us

Doctors in the practice may be contacted during normal surgery hours. If the doctor is with a patient, a message will be taken and you will be advised by the reception staff when it is likely that the doctor will return your call. Your call will immediately be put through to a doctor or a nurse in an emergency.

Please note that all patient enquiries will require an appointment. Please telephone our reception team or book an appointment online.

- **Phone Number**: (02) 6257 1000
- **Email Address**: reception@garemaplacesurgery.com.au
- **Post Box**: PO Box 628 Canberra City ACT 2601
- **Book Online**: available via the Bookings page

### Practice Manager
Anita Tammaro has been Practice Manager at Garema Place Surgery since March 2016. Anita has worked in General Practice for approximately 20 years and has a wealth of experience in this field. Anita is always willing to assist and is very happy to receive feedback on any aspect of our service.

### Your Privacy and Rights as a Patient
Garema Place Surgery is fully compliant with all Commonwealth and Territory Privacy Legislation requirements. All team members have signed confidentiality agreements and understand their responsibilities in regard to your privacy and the confidentiality of your health record. Your record will be accessed by authorised persons only.

The full Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available for download from the Contact Us page.

### Feedback
We are very happy to receive feedback about our service. You may provide feedback in writing, via email or online. Please address this correspondence to feedback@garemaplacesurgery.com.au.

If you are not satisfied with the process, you may also wish to contact the Health Services Commissioner:

Health Services Commissioner
ACT Human Rights Commission
GPO Box 158,
Canberra ACT 2601

Telephone: (02) 6205 2222
Email: feedback@garemaplacesurgery.com.au

Patients are also invited to take the practice's satisfaction Survey.

## Survey

We are interested in receiving your feedback about the care provided at our Practice. Please take a few minutes to complete this survey and return it to us. Your responses are important to us.

The survey asks patients to rate (Excellent / Good / Normal / Bad / Worst):
- Ease of making appointments for checkups (physical exams, well visits, routine follow-up appointments)
- Ease of making appointments for sickness
- Ease in communication with your Doctor by telephone when you call during office hours
- The time it takes someone from our office to respond when you call or email with an urgent problem
- Waiting time in our office
- Ease in obtaining follow-up information and care (test results, medicines, care instructions)
- Overall medical care at your Doctor's office
- Our office's appearance
- Our office's convenience (location, parking, hours, office layout)
- The way we teach you about improving your health
- How caring is your Doctor
- How caring are our nursing staff
- How caring are our office staff

The survey also collects the patient's full name, email, phone number, number of visits in the past 12 months, age, length of time as a patient, gender, and open-ended comments on how the practice could improve its service. Submission requires acceptance of the Privacy Policy.

---

## Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. It is Garema Place Surgery's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect from you across our website, https://garemaplacesurgery.com.au, and other sites we own and operate.

We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we're collecting it and how it will be used.

We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we'll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorised access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.

We don't share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law.

Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies.

You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services.

Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.

This policy is effective as of 4 September 2020.
